biotools.summary: Web application that re-analyses a human DNA data file the user already holds and returns a report in which each finding is attributed to a named, versioned public source. Inputs are genotyping-array raw data exports (23andMe, AncestryDNA, MyHeritage, FamilyTreeDNA, LivingDNA) and whole-genome VCF, gVCF, BAM or CRAM files on GRCh38 or GRCh37. Variants are normalised to GRCh38, annotated and matched against curated gene panels and ClinVar-listed variants. The report covers pharmacogenes read against CPIC guidance, carrier status, ClinVar and ACMG secondary-findings matches, polygenic scores from the PGS Catalog, traits, mitochondrial and Y-chromosome haplogroups and ancestry composition, and states what the supplied file could not read. Carrier status and the clinical-findings panel require a sequenced genome. Reports are paid for; the output is informational and is not a diagnosis or medical advice.
